subject.title: Workspaces: add stream and computed bindings

question: Should Workspaces widgets receive the complete `presence` and `sessions.changed` payloads through the new stream-binding contract?
rationale: Source validation can restrict the event names, but only the Workspaces owner can approve the payloads as a stable plugin/widget authorization boundary.

options.title: Approve both events
options.body: Confirm both full payloads as supported Workspaces inputs and land after runtime and upgrade proof is added.

options.title: Expose projections
options.body: Define reduced Workspaces-specific event payloads instead of forwarding the complete gateway broadcasts.

options.title: Defer streams
options.body: Land computed bindings and explicit output selection while holding stream bindings for a separate security-contract decision.

recommendation.title: Approve both events
recommendation.body: Confirm both full payloads as supported Workspaces inputs and land after runtime and upgrade proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Workspaces foundation establishes the gateway, persistence, and Control UI boundary being extended.
